entry.title: New: RES23-196 (Honolulu) — CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF GRAPHIC DISPLAY PANELS VALUED AT $2,718.00, TO THE CITY FROM THE FRIENDS OF THE HONOLULU BOTANICAL GARDENS FOR THE PURPOSE OF EDUCATING THE PUBLIC ABOUT THE BUTTERFLIES OF HAWAIʻI AND THE GARDEN PLANTS WHICH SUPPORTS THEIR LIFECYCLES THAT WILL BE DISPLAYED AT THE FOSTER BOTANICAL GARDEN.

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution were adopted.
